name: call_with_no_open_scope
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. Call deposit of 1 on a new account from a fresh empty context, from a thread with one, with a context value naming a scope that has closed, with one this host did not issue, from a copy of a closed scope's context, and from a thread with that copy. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: Each call fails as a mistake in the calling code, a UsageError that says which of the three it is, and is never sent: the total is 0. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: principal_not_valid
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1. Every account the case names is new to the reference provider.
procedure: 1. In a scope whose principal has an empty subject, an empty issuer, a lone surrogate, a lone surrogate in a claim list, an integer beyond 2^53-1 in a claim, or a sent form of 4097 bytes, call deposit of 1 on a new account. 2. Read that account's total in-process.
expected: Each leg's call fails with internal, the fixed text and the scope's trace identifier, with no cause, and is never sent: the total is 0. The caller's host logs the cause under the identifier. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: principal_read_from_its_sent_form
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. In a scope whose principal has a sent form of exactly 4096 bytes, holds U+FFFF, or holds a claim of each admitted kind, call seen.
expected: The provider receives the principal decoded from its sent form: the same issuer, subject and claims, over both transports.
